claims.exact_statement: For every genuine Boolean core g, every integer d>=1, p=2^-d, and the function F equal to g at one fresh d-bit control word and 1 elsewhere, let I_ctl=2p d Pr[g=-1]. Then G(F)<=pG(g)+K_act pI(g)+C_star I_ctl, where K_act=2+7(1+2/e)/ln2<19.530 and C_star=1+2(1+1/e)/ln2<4.947. If G(g)<=aI(g)+bU(g) with 0<=b<1, then G(F)<=a'I(F)+bU(F), where a'=max(a+K_act,C_star+b(K_act-1)).
proof_dependencies: direct Walsh expansion reproduced in this bundle
elementary derivative and physical-influence bounds reproduced in this bundle
claims.scope: ONE FRESH ACTIVATION LAYER; ARBITRARY BOOLEAN TERMINAL CORE
does_not_prove: a depth-independent constant under arbitrary repeated coherent core changes
claims.first_unproved_line: Prevent the additive K_act cost from being charged once per coherent core change in an arbitrary nested hierarchy.

claims.exact_statement: Let A be the restriction-closed class consisting of constants, signed parities, and fresh one-point activations of signed parities with arbitrary data dimension and arbitrary control depth d. Every F in A satisfies G(F)<=K_act I(F), U(F)<=K_act I(F), and H(F)<=(2+2K_act)I(F)<41.059I(F).
hypotheses: membership in the explicitly defined restriction-closed parity-activation class A
proof_dependencies: restriction induction proved in the report/proof
claims.first_unproved_line: Extend the single-use core Jensen-gap payment to arbitrary coherent hierarchies without a depth factor.
